title: Tips for Monitoring Aerobic Exercise Intensity
claims: ACSM describes exercise intensity monitoring by %HRmax, with moderate intensity estimated at 65–75% of maximal heart rate and vigorous intensity at 76–96%.
ACSM describes the talk test: a steady conversation is associated with moderate intensity, while only a few words are sustainable at vigorous intensity.
ACSM describes rating of perceived exertion on a 0–10 scale, with moderate intensity targeting an RPE of 3–4 and vigorous intensity an RPE of 5–7.
ACSM also describes step-rate and motion-sensor methods for monitoring aerobic intensity.
The document gives no race-time-derived pace-zone percentage table; intensity anchors are heart rate, perceived effort, talk test and step rate.
